mapper.insert: WITH locked AS (SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(#{lockKey},0))) INSERT INTO ad_uplift_assignment(assignment_id,request_id,user_id,ad_id,advertiser_id,item_id,treatment,propensity, pctr,pcvr,quality,relevance,bid,ad_bucket,model_version,assigned_at,outcome_due_at) SELECT #{row.assignmentId},#{row.requestId},#{row.userId},#{row.adId},#{row.advertiserId},#{row.itemId}, #{row.treatment},#{row.propensity},#{row.pctr},#{row.pcvr},#{row.quality},#{row.relevance},#{row.bid}, #{row.bucket},#{row.modelVersion},#{row.assignedAt},#{row.outcomeDueAt} FROM locked WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ad_uplift_assignment WHERE user_id=#{row.userId} AND advertiser_id=#{row.advertiserId} AND outcome_due_at > #{row.assignedAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
